briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI race toward 10T parameter models amid escalating compute shortages

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies with multiple frontier labs pushing multimodal agents into production. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows over autonomous systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation gains traction in enterprise pilots.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI's Orion-2 enters internal testing with 4.2T parameters. Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus while Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3 Ultra with native video reasoning. Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B variant.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships 3M Blackwell GPUs this quarter. Microsoft and xAI announce joint 200k H100 cluster in Texas. TSMC reports 40% YoY growth in AI accelerator wafers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory caps on training compute slow US labs more than Chinese competitors by 2027?
